entries.prompt:
Create ONE finished, premium hand-painted cinematic survival-game inventory product icon, as a clean product cutout with a genuinely transparent RGBA background. The supplied current artwork crop is the authority for our label: preserve its exact fictional manufacturer logo, existing English/French print, ingredient illustration, borders, typography hierarchy and colors. Form convincing physical packaging around that artwork with natural material folds, subtle surface wear and crisp readable printing; do not output a flat label tile or a preview of an old game mesh. Use the original concept only for the polish, product framing and rendering finish, never copy its brands, words, colors or label arrangement. Use soft broad upper-left light, restrained lower-right self-shading, readable midtones and small material highlights; no heavy black ambient-occlusion bands. Centre the complete product with safe transparent margins, generous approximately 82-88 percent longest-side occupancy, an intact silhouette and no cropping. No UI, no scene, no hands, no tabletop, no extra food props, no extra products, no watermark, no invented slogans, no fake checkerboard, no grey/white matte or long cast shadow. Deliver a sharp high-resolution square master suitable for clean downsampling to 96-128px; preserve actual alpha and fine edge transparency. Subject: one broad puffy chip bag with a full middle, uneven soft shoulders, gathered lower corners and narrow crimped top and bottom seals; soft flexible foil rather than a rectangular slab. Palette and identity: gold ochre with the original dark Driftwood Snacks ribbon and pale potato/chip illustration. Camera: mostly frontal, 7 degrees yaw and 5 degrees elevation, a slight 3-degree tilt. The visible manufacturer must remain "Driftwood Snacks" and the product remains "Potato Chips", quantity "180 g". Keep the French wording, accent marks and every existing graphic detail from the supplied image; do not re-typeset from metadata or replace the label with a similar design. Input A is the isolated existing front artwork from assets-source/provision-art-v2/snacks-original.png, pixel rectangle [384, 512, 768, 1024]. Input A supplies artwork, not the final object shape. If a concept reference is supplied as Input B, it supplies finish and silhouette presentation only. The result is an inventory-only raster portrait; do not change or imitate the current world/held 3D model. Preserve the original logo, illustration and letterform aspect ratios; use only gentle perspective, never mechanically squeeze a portrait label into a horizontal strip. If needed, retain the supplied print as an intact label panel with matching unprinted packaging around it.
Final constraints: Use ONLY the attached OUR ARTWORK as the printed identity. No additional concept image is supplied or to be copied. Render one finished natural package in a premium clean hand-painted survival inventory style. Large readable main lettering, exact original brand. TRUE alpha with clean antialiasing and absolutely no stray coloured specks/halos outside the package. Show real folded shape and thickness, not an old game mesh or flat tile.
